description: Build a minimal valid `<apex-grid>` config: `{ columns, data }`. When both are omitted, a small users table is generated. When only `columns` is omitted, they are inferred from the keys of the first data row with `type` inferred per column. Pass `enableSortAndFilter: true` to opt every generated column in.

columns.description: Array of ColumnConfiguration. Each column needs `{ key, type? }` where key is a real key of each data row.

data.description: Array of row objects. Keys referenced by `column.key` must exist on each row.

enableSortAndFilter.description: Convenience: add `sort: true` and `filter: true` to every generated column.

resizable.description: Convenience: add `resizable: true` to every generated column.

name: apexgrid_generate_config
title: Generate apex-grid config
